title: Observing Japanese IME conversion without recording text: Observability limits, a cross-platform logger, and a synthetic-input validation
description: Artifacts of a study on observing Japanese IME conversion without recording its text: the log formats, the scenario generator, the synthetic-input emitter, the reference input fields, the standalone logger, the analysis pipeline, the aggregate results of the experiment, and the export tooling. Code is released under Apache-2.0. Data (including the phrases and readings in kit/corpus/data/) and documents are released under CC BY 4.0; both licenses are described in README.md.
